thread:
maya: FYI CedarBridge signed the statement of work. They want a scoped pen-test covering RBAC, KMS policies, and retention for audit logs. Proposed window: Thu 2026-06-24. Need owners, an evidence bucket, and retest guidance.

liam: I'll volunteer for the RBAC side. Proposal: create a `cedar-reviewer` role limited to `sts:AssumeRole` with MFA + session duration 1800s. We'll attach a permissions boundary that is strictly read-only.

rachel: On KMS: we should avoid giving decrypt to the assessor. Provide `kms:DescribeKey`, and `kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext` only. Also prepare a key-policy snapshot and an explicit diff. I'll prepare those artifacts by Tue EOD.

security-bot: Review checklist created: evidence-path, ephemeral-role, kms-policy-diff, audit-sampling, dry-run, post-review revocation. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/pen-test-sop.

tom: For audit logs, I recommend enabling a timeboxed CloudTrail trail that writes to s3://sec-evidence/cedarbridge/2026-06-24/ and enabling digest verification. We'll also ship logs to SIEM with a bounded retention export of 120 days for the engagement.

maya: Evidence upload rules: small files use KMS-wrapped PutObject, large artifacts (>200MB) via presigned PUT with expire=1h. Tag all objects with `engagement: CED-0624`. No plaintext credentials in artifacts.

liam: How do we coordinate vulnerability findings? Suggest assessors create issues in SEC-TRIAGE with severity labels. High/critical should trigger a pager to oncall and create a remediation ticket assigned by resource tag.

rachel: KMS proxy plan: deploy a proxy that only accepts `GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext` and logs request metadata. We'll add an additional condition in the key policy that only allows calls from the proxy principal during the review window. Example condition snippet I'll include in the evidence folder.

security-bot: Action items assigned: SEC-6120 (create cedar-reviewer role) -> liam; SEC-6121 (KMS policy diff + proxy playbook) -> rachel; SEC-6122 (audit trail + bucket + SIEM hook) -> tom.

maya: Retest: request a 7-day retest window. Tentative retest slot: Wed 2026-07-01 16:00-18:00 UTC. CedarBridge asked for an accelerated retest if fixes are ready earlier.

liam: Canary plan for RBAC change: deploy role and expose to assessor via a dedicated account. Run a 10-minute canary verifying only DescribeRole/SimulatePrincipalPolicy calls succeed. If any access outside expected appears, revoke role. We'll document checks.

tom: Scheduling dry-run: can we do a 30-min dry-run on Mon 2026-06-22 09:00 UTC to validate assume-role flow, the audit bucket writer, and SIEM ingestion? infra-oncall can you book?

infra-oncall: Dry-run scheduled Mon 2026-06-22 09:00-09:30 UTC. I'll provide a checklist and collect test logs at s3://sec-evidence/cedarbridge/dryrun/ and channel the report to #eng-security.

rachel: On the KMS diff: I'll include the current policy, proposed minimal policy, and an automated test script that performs `GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext` and `DescribeKey` via the proxy. Script will use STS assume-role and not leak plaintext keys.

maya: Also add telemetry toggles: raise auth logging to debug for the engagement window and capture extra context fields (principal, sessionName, sourceIp). Keep those logs for 90 days and upload a sampled copy to the evidence bucket.

liam: One more ops question: do we want assessors to have the ability to upload repro artifacts to SEC-TRIAGE tickets? That usually helps triage.

maya: Yes, allow attachments into SEC-TRIAGE by provisioning a presigned PUT to a secure subpath and require tagging with `reporter: cedar`. Gate uploads via a short-lived token.

security-bot: Reminder: revoke all ephemeral roles immediately after review window and rotate any credentials that were used for proxy. Also run artifact integrity checks and store checksums in the evidence folder.

maya: Great work. I'll send CedarBridge the official questionnaire and the proposed windows. We'll use SEC tickets for implementation updates. Ping me if upload errors occur. :white_check_mark:

liam: Thanks everyone.
